explanation: A bat that fails to feed can quickly run out of energy. Vampire bats are likelier to share with roost-mates that have shared with them before, a well-studied case of returning favours.

claims.text: Vampire bats regurgitate blood to feed roost-mates that failed to find a meal.
Vampire finches, leeches and mosquitoes do not regurgitate blood to feed others.
A vampire bat that fails to feed soon runs short of energy and can starve.
Vampire bats are more likely to share food with bats that have shared with them before.
